title: Committed executable binary app.bin (2.0 MB) is an unreviewable artifact in the repo
evidence:
$ git ls-files | grep -E 'app.bin|game/'
app.bin
$ ls -la
-rwxr-xr-x@  1 moses  staff  2057480  9 Aug 14:39 app.bin
detail: A committed executable bypasses source review (supply-chain hygiene). Otherwise clean for this chunk: core imports only core:encoding/json, core:fmt, core:mem, core:slice — no network listener, shell-out, file IO, or path handling anywhere in the diff; the log reader bounds-checks its input.
recommended_fix: Remove app.bin from git and ignore it; distribute binaries via releases.
